nodes.description: LlamaIndex ReAct Agent with three tools: semantic_search (ChromaDB vector query), get_track_history (track trajectory lookup), visual_requery (SigLIP 2 embedding → ChromaDB image-to-image comparison via FeatureBank).

nodes.label: Cognition Trigger Mechanisms
nodes.description: Two triggers: High-Entropy Trigger (frame entropy > 0.9 triggers scene context analysis) and Anomaly Trigger (risk_objects detected: knife, fire, smoke). When neither fires, orchestrator only writes index, no LLM invocation.

nodes.label: Mamba Whole Graph Preset
nodes.description: Production baseline preset using whole-detect CUDA graph with TRT backbone + Mamba head + decode in single replay. native_640, ReID off, 175 FPS. IDF1 73.4%, MOTA 76.9%, HOTA 66.6% on 7-seq SDP. Three-layer CUDA graph architecture (WholeDetect + NMS + Tracker).

nodes.label: Mamba Detection Head (Option F)
nodes.description: Replaces standard YOLO Detect head with Mamba Selective State Space (S6) modules for long-range spatial dependency modeling. Architecture: input_proj(1x1)→downsample(4x)→MambaBlock×2→Cross-Scan(4-dir)→PixelShuffle upsample→skip connection→cls_head+reg_head. Built at src/saccade/perception/temporal_yolo/mamba_head.py.

nodes.label: Cross-Scan Mamba
nodes.description: Four-direction spatial scan (original, x-flip, y-flip, xy-flip) through shared MambaBlock followed by mean pooling. Eliminates row-major bias with zero parameter growth. Critical for replacing temporal blocks with spatial context.

nodes.label: PixelShuffle Learned Upsampling
nodes.description: Replaces bilinear interpolation with Conv(3x3)→PixelShuffle for learning-based upsampling. MOTA +14.3pp vs F.interpolate. Has automatic fallback to bilinear interpolation when loading legacy weights missing upsample parameters.

nodes.label: Three-Layer CUDA Graph Architecture
nodes.description: Three CUDA graphs merge ~300 kernel launches into ~4 replays/frame: L1 WholeDetect Graph (resize+TRT backbone+Mamba head+decode, ~280→1), L2 NMS Graph (~5→1), L3 Tracker Graph (~15→1). Reduces detect from 7.4ms to 3.25ms, track from 1.4ms to 0.53ms.

nodes.label: Mamba 3-Phase Training Pipeline
nodes.description: Phase 0: Feature cache precompute (saves P3/P4/P5 + cls/reg targets). Phase 1: Distillation (MSE loss, student learns teacher Detect head outputs). Phase 2: GT fine-tuning with v8DetectionLoss (DFL+CIoU+BCE). Follows principle: precompute > realtime compute, FeatureCache stores pooled embeddings not intermediate FPN features.

nodes.label: v14 Production Checkpoint
nodes.description: runs/mamba_gt_vgt_mamba_v14/best.ckpt. Cross-Scan + PixelShuffle + N=16 SSM fix, pure spatial (no temporal blocks). IDF1 72.4%, MOTA 77.3%. Key finding: SSM internal params (A_log/D/conv1d/x_proj/dt_proj) were never trained (frozen-SSM regime), only gate/readout/upsampling/heads were updated.

nodes.label: Frozen-SSM Regime
nodes.description: Discovery that v14 lineage never trained SSM internal parameters. A_log/D/conv1d/x_proj/dt_proj are bit-exact to initialization. Frozen SSM acts as implicit regularizer (reservoir-like structured mixer). Full-grad training degrades performance; unfreezing from convergence is neutral-to-slightly-positive. Controlled via --scan-stop-grad flag.

nodes.label: T3→T1 Temporal Curriculum
nodes.description: Two-phase GT2 curriculum: Phase A (T=3 temporal training, 15ep, cache, stop-grad) followed by Phase B (T=1 pure spatial re-adaptation, 15ep). First to surpass legacy v14 with IDF1 75.4. Gain mechanism is shaping pressure not temporal inference — T=3 training forces spatial path to produce cross-frame consistent features. Deployment is T=1 single-frame with zero cost.

nodes.label: v14-R Training Protocol
nodes.description: Canonical training contract MAMBA-V14R-20260612-R1. Defines controlled v14-R and strict-clean v14-R protocols. Fixed seed 20260612, selection seq MOT17-02-SDP, 6 training seqs, clip_len=4/stride=4. Selection via detector size recall first, then HOTA/IDF1/FP/FN. Training loss forbidden as sole selector.

nodes.label: Detection Design Evolution
nodes.description: Option B (Frozen YOLO) → Option C (Joint Training) → Option D (Gate+Decoder, NO-GO, IDF1 31.7%) → Option E (Gate+Standard Head+FT, IDF1 57.2%) → Option E-v2 (Quality-Gated Temporal Fusion, MOTA 54.2%) → Option F (Mamba SSM Head, active).

nodes.label: Temporal Direction Conclusion
nodes.description: All attempts to add temporal modules on v14 Cross-Scan spatial baseline failed to surpass pure spatial. v15 (+SSM temporal): IDF1 58.6% (-13.8pp). v17 (+TemporalAttention): IDF1 69.2% (-3.2pp). Root causes: train-test distribution mismatch, Cross-Scan already provides global spatial context, MOT17 data insufficient for temporal SSM convergence.

nodes.label: Mamba Training Success Factors
nodes.description: Five ranked factors: (1) Capacity ratio: frozen backbone + 10M head prevents overfitting on ~5300 samples. (2) Frozen SSM = implicit regularizer. (3) Teacher prior: mild domain-adaptation supervision. (4) Three-stage curriculum: dense imitation→mixed→pure GT. (5) T3→T1 temporal shaping for feature consistency.

nodes.label: YOLO26m Capacity Comparison
nodes.description: YOLO26m (P3/P4/P5: 256/512/512 channels vs s: 128/256/512) with m-T3T1: recall/MOTA win at IDF1 parity. Small-object recall 0.900 (lineage high). MOTA 78.4 (+0.8), IDs 442. But AssA -2.4 due to structural DetA↔AssA tradeoff from noisier small-box height estimates degrading bridge relink.

nodes.label: GPUByteTracker
nodes.description: Core MOT engine fully implemented in C++/CUDA with zero-copy GPU pipeline. Dual-stage Sinkhorn matching (high-score + low-score). Hybrid cost matrix: Cost = (1-w)*IoU_Distance + w*Cosine_Distance with Strong ReID Gate (CosSim>0.75 forces match). GPU Kalman Filter with GMC correction. Track state machine: Tentative→Tracked→Lost→Removed.

nodes.label: Track State Machine
nodes.description: Tentative (new tracks needing confirm_streak consecutive matches, default 3), Tracked (stable matched tracks), Lost (unmatched tracks kept in track_buffer frames for ReID recovery), Removed (expired tracks released). Supports adaptive confirmation based on score and target culling under VRAM pressure.

nodes.label: GPU Global Motion Compensation (GMC)
nodes.description: Camera motion alignment fully on GPU via FFT phase correlation with parallel 256-thread peak-find reduction. Reduced per-frame GMC from 0.71ms to 0.28ms (12.5× speedup). Affine matrix feeds tracker Kalman correction and detection Mamba flow gate. GMC is the only positive-contributing module in ablation (IDF1 +2.0pp, IDs -63%).

nodes.label: Kalman R-Scale Adaptive Tuning
nodes.description: Dynamic Kalman R matrix scaling. kalman_r_scale=2.8 gives IDF1 +1.9pp, IDs -82, FP -940. Higher trust in motion model. Light compensation dynamically adjusts R based on frame brightness for stable night tracking.

nodes.label: Perception Layer (L1)
nodes.description: Saccade retina and visual cortex. Handles real-time high-frequency visual data: GStreamer NVDEC decode→NV12-to-RGB GPU conversion→YOLO26 TRT detection→GPUByteTracker tracking. Zero-copy 5-Buffer pool. Saccade Heartbeat triggers SigLIP 2 feature extraction every 10 frames. Achieves 149 FPS single-stream, 6.68ms E2E latency P99<9.3ms.

nodes.label: Track Lifecycle Module
nodes.description: Manages track Tentative/Confirmed/Lost state machine, dead-track eviction, and Tracker LRU release. Supports AsyncDispatcher LRU Tracker mechanism (default max 8 streams). ID stability filter available as module-level option but off in mamba_whole_graph preset.

nodes.label: Motion Module
nodes.description: Motion consistency verification, velocity/acceleration EMA smoothing (vel_alpha=0.3, acc_alpha=0.15). Motion-only relink was NO-GO (89% candidates blocked by age gate, gain≈noise). OA-SORT OAO duration-ramp revived in mamba_whole_graph as temporal occlusion penalty (oao_tau=0.50, oao_ramp_frames=25).

nodes.label: ReID Vector Layer (L2)
nodes.description: Converts visual signals to semantic embedding vectors. Cropper (GPU RoI batch extraction), SigLIP 2 TRT feature extractor (dynamic batch N_opt=8), DriftHandler with EMA semantic centroid and warm-up phase (alpha=0.7 for new objects). Saccade Heartbeat: sparse 10-frame updates prevent EMA contamination, cutting IDt 64% and ReID compute 90%.

nodes.label: FeatureBank
nodes.description: 768-dim vectorized matrix with fixed-size tensor storage (max_ids × feat_dim). O(1) dual-hash index via _slot_map Dict[(track_id, stream_id) → row_index]. find_matches_batch uses torch.mm for parallel cosine similarity across all targets. Cross-camera matching uses stricter threshold (+0.03). Supports stream_map for multi-stream sharing.

nodes.label: Appearance Capability Ceiling
nodes.description: MOT17 identities are inherently hard to separate in embedding space. Clear 200+px box rank-1 only 57%, intra-inter gap ~0.03, long-gap rank-1 collapses 10-37%. Five models + four mechanisms + super-resolution all hit same ceiling. Appearance relink gate AUC≈0.50. Mamba head features for relink: hard pool AUC 0.438. Appearance direction concluded NO-GO.

nodes.label: SigLIP 2 Feature Extractor
nodes.description: Upgraded from SigLIP to SigLIP 2 with stronger contrastive representation. TRT-accelerated inference engine supporting dynamic batch up to N_opt=8. Batch inference time: 0.82ms for 8 objects. Zero-copy cropping <0.15ms. Semantic latency: <5 frames from object entry to stable centroid.

nodes.label: Resource Layer (L6)
nodes.description: Decision brain for VRAM resource monitoring and system balancing. ResourceManager monitors VRAM via NVML and outputs degradation commands. FrameSelector adjusts L1 detection frequency based on L2 drift scores. Four-level degradation: NORMAL(<85%)→REDUCED(>85%, shrink buffer pool)→FAST_PATH(>92%, pause L2 SigLIP+L5 RAG)→EMERGENCY(>96%, resolution 640→320, target culling, track_buffer 30→10). Hysteresis protection: downgrade requires 5% below trigger.

nodes.label: VRAM Level Named Shared Memory
nodes.description: Cross-process VRAM level broadcast via POSIX named shared memory (saccade_vram_level). VRAMLevelWriter writes 1-byte DegradationLevel, VRAMLevelReader reads it. Writer auto-unlinks stale segments on restart. Reader falls back to NORMAL on missing shared memory.

nodes.label: Storage Layer (L4)
nodes.description: Long-term memory providing semantic spatio-temporal retrieval. ChromaStore wrapping ChromaDB with HNSW indexing. Async DB client with batch insertion (every 1s or 50 items). Metadata stores BBox, Timestamp, Confidence, TrackID.

nodes.label: ChromaDB Memory Collection
nodes.description: Collection saccade_memories at storage/chroma_db. Stores content+metadata+embedding via add_memory(). Metadata fields: frame_id, entropy, objects (comma-separated string), is_anomaly (0|1), timestamp. hybrid_query() supports text, embedding, time range, anomaly filter, object filter.

nodes.label: Redis Event Infrastructure
nodes.description: Dual event paths: Redis List saccade:events (TTL 3600s, micro-batch via MicroBatcher: 100ms or 50 items) and Redis Stream saccade:stream (consumer group orchestrator_group, MAXLEN=10000). Event schema: event_id (uuid4), timestamp, type (entropy_trigger), metadata (entropy_value, source_path, frame_id, objects).

nodes.label: FastAPI Retrieval API
nodes.description: REST API at src/saccade/api/server.py. Endpoints: GET / (status), GET /objects (active objects from Redis), GET /objects/{obj_id} (single object data with dwell_time), POST /search (hybrid query: text+n_results+start_time+is_anomaly).

nodes.label: Streaming Layer (L3)
nodes.description: Isolation zone between perception (L1/L2) and storage (L4). Solves bandwidth mismatch between high-speed perception frame rate and slow database writes. EventLoop (asyncio-based), RedisCache for real-time track data, MicroBatcher aggregating 100ms detection events into single messages.

nodes.label: GStreamer Zero-Copy Decoder
nodes.description: GstZeroCopyDecoder uses NVDEC (nvh264dec) for GPU hardware decode outputting NV12 (YUV420). GPU color conversion _nv12_to_rgb_gpu performs YUV→RGB entirely on GPU using BT.601 formula. C++ GstClient manages 5-buffer pool with atomic state machine (EMPTY/WRITING/READY/PROCESSING) and automatic frame dropping when buffer full.

nodes.label: RTSP MediaMTX Contract
nodes.description: Canonical defaults: host 127.0.0.1, port 8554. Reader credentials: reader/readpass123. Publisher credentials: publisher/pubpass123. Path naming: live (single), stream_<id> (multi), detected (output). Helper API: build_rtsp_url(), build_reader_url(), build_publisher_url(), build_stream_path().

nodes.label: Stream Recovery Mechanism
nodes.description: Automatic RTSP reconnection: detects disconnection when 5s without frame via grab_tensor(). Recovery: release GStreamer pipe, exponential backoff reconnect (1s, 2s, 4s, 8s), clear object IDs lost >10s.

nodes.label: Trigger Module
nodes.description: Async ReID feature processing and RAG trigger decisions. DynamicReIDController with cooldown_frames + birth_death_lost_min triggers. Integrates VRAM degradation broadcast to skip RAG at FAST_PATH and above. Saccade Heartbeat frame update isolation gating.

nodes.label: DynamicReIDController
nodes.description: Redesigned trigger based on signal strength not event counts. Main failure mode: lost→new fragmentation. Uses short accurate geometry memory (5-frame bbox history) + long noisy trend memory (decayed event scores). Per-frame local signals for new, lost, unstable smoothed with EMA. Triggers when weighted sum exceeds threshold.

nodes.label: Semantic Relink Module
nodes.description: Appearance-based Hungarian association, reranking (Rerank Phase 3) for false-accept filtering, and cross-camera/long-lost identity recovery. Implements Sinkhorn Auction hybrid association. GPU bidirectional bridge relink is default-on in preset (IDF1 +2.1, AssA +2.8, IDs -13.6%, FP -14%).

nodes.label: GPU Bidirectional Bridge Relink
nodes.description: Midpoint bridge relink with px=0.25 and scale gate. Strictly positive across all metrics: IDF1 +2.1, AssA +2.8, IDs -13.6%, FP -14%. Default-on in preset. Only bridge path active; archive/revive is zero due to track_buffer structural limit.

nodes.label: Depth Ordering Crossing-Swap Detection
nodes.description: Pre-occlusion box geometry (foot_y primary, area fallback) predicts front/back in crossing-swaps at 89.8% accuracy across all 7 MOT17-SDP sequences (97% when cue is decisive). First signal attacking occlusion crossing-swap bottleneck (109 swaps = 22% of baseline IDs) without appearance or velocity-direction. Same-height gate default-on (+0.5 IDF1).

nodes.label: Kalman Physical Relink Gating
nodes.description: Phase 0 landed (default off): forward chi-square gating (chi2=9.4877), cos-theta direction gate, anisotropic cigar-cloud (person height 1.65m anchoring, along-track acceleration 2.0, lateral 1.0), physical speed limit (max 8 m/s). Phase 1: delayed claim skeleton with velocity acquisition + deferred alias remap. Phase 2: bidirectional midpoint bridge gating.

nodes.label: Gate Feedback Mechanism
nodes.description: Training-time simulation of tracking closed loop. Renders previous frame GT boxes as Gaussian heatmap (TrackerGateInput) fed into spatial gate with probability gt_ratio. Ineffective with ungated feature cache (cache mode + gate_input=None means gate feedback doesn't reach Mamba).

nodes.label: Feature Cache System
nodes.description: Precomputed frozen teacher FPN features + Detect head cls/reg targets saved per-frame as .pt files. manifest.json records schema, SHA-256, sequence list, frame counts. Training reads cache skipping backbone forward. ~5.3 MB/frame at 640 resolution. 7-seq MOT17 = ~28 GB. Supports CPU RAM mode for <40GB VRAM.

nodes.label: Selective Scan CUDA Kernel
nodes.description: Custom CUDA kernel (selective_scan_fwd) at src/tracking/mamba_scan.cu. Maps (B, D) pipeline to one CUDA block with warp-level shuffle for associative scan. Performance: 6400-length sequence 2.97ms at 26.5 GFLOPS. N≤32 fits single warp. Per-channel A support with a_per_channel flag. Kernel accounts for 6.8% GPU time (68µs/frame) in production.

nodes.label: Mamba Head TRT Export (In Progress)
nodes.description: SelectiveScan TRT Plugin (mamba_scan_plugin.cpp) wrapping selective_scan_fwd. ONNX export via torch.autograd.Function.symbolic(). TRT engine build from ONNX→FP16. Not yet completed: parity check vs PyTorch eager, integration into inference pipeline, INT8 quantization, dynamic batching.

nodes.label: mamba_whole_graph YAML Parameters
nodes.description: Key parameters: tiling=native_640, preprocess=none (stretch-resize), reid_mode=off, gmc=true (downscale=4), match_thresh=0.50, new_track_thresh=0.28, kalman_r_scale=2.8, confirm_streak=3, fuse_score_weight=0.0 (IoU-only), interpolate_max_gap=35, use_whole_graph=true, use_tracker_graph=true.

nodes.label: Per-Channel A + MOT20 Conclusion
nodes.description: per-channel SSM A (per-channel independent decay) + MOT20 mixed training → NO-GO. DetA -1.8pp (detection itself degraded, not just association). MOT20 domain shift pulled head away from MOT17 good position. Adding capacity on small data + domain-shift data only harder to converge.

nodes.label: v14 Replication Result
nodes.description: Full-chain replication (teacher e12→cache→distill→GT1→GT2). Replica IDF1 73.4 vs legacy 75.1. Residual -1.7 IDF1/-2pp recall attributed to unrecoverable factors (no historical seed, scheduler differences, N=1-era warm-start). Verdict: recipe substantially reproducible, v14 not lucky checkpoint. Multi-seed noise bandwidth 0.4pp.

nodes.label: SSM Unfreeze Results
nodes.description: Unfreezing SSM from replica convergence: neutral to slightly positive (MOTA/HOTA +0.8). Train loss improves (2.548→2.149) but doesn't translate to detector recall. Full-grad from scratch is harmful; full-grad from convergence is not toxic. A_log max delta only 0.010 after 30 epochs unfrozen.
