nodes.label: CUDA D2H Staging Memory Leak on WSL2+WDDM
nodes.summary: Pageable cudaMemcpyAsync DeviceToHost on WSL2+WDDM causes driver-side pinned staging buffer accumulation (~1.2GB/s RssAnon growth). Fix: use cudaMallocHost pinned destinations in SequenceRunner.
nodes.norm_label: cuda d2h staging memory leak on wsl2+wddm

nodes.label: VmSize vs VmRSS Measurement Correction
nodes.summary: VmSize (~60GB) is CUDA virtual address mapping, not real DRAM. VmRSS/RssAnon is the true memory pressure metric. Must measure python3 child process, not uv parent.

nodes.label: Stale .so Loader Artifact False Negative
nodes.summary: LD_LIBRARY_PATH trailing colon resolves to CWD, causing stale repo-root .so to load instead of build/ .so. Verify with /proc/pid/maps, not just Python import path.

nodes.label: Non-Causes Ruled Out in D2H Leak Investigation
nodes.summary: Ruled out: TRT engine deserialize, TRT context create, CppSequenceRunner ctor, cv::imread, cv::split, TRT inference, glibc fragmentation (MALLOC_MMAP_THRESHOLD).
nodes.norm_label: non-causes ruled out in d2h leak investigation

nodes.label: Pinned D2H Memory Fix in SequenceRunner
nodes.summary: h_out_count/ids/boxes/scores_pinned_ allocated via cudaMallocHost. After fix, VmRSS stabilizes at ~1.22GB (was ~16.6GB). TRT context lazy init also kept as supporting change.
nodes.norm_label: pinned d2h memory fix in sequencerunner

nodes.label: Kalman R-Shape Affine Correction (g(h)) NO-GO
nodes.summary: Affine R shape g(h) = a + b·h correction caused IDF1 −0.4 / AssA −0.63. Legacy h/20 overestimates large-box noise, which acts as beneficial smoothing prior for nearby slow targets.

nodes.label: Kalman f(score) v2 Score-Conditioned Noise Scaling
nodes.summary: f(score) v2 (s0=0.9305, amplification-only, clamp 1-30) gives IDF1 +1.5 / AssA +0.86 but DetA −1.44 / MOTA −0.4. Default off due to detection regression on moving-camera sequences (05/13).
nodes.norm_label: kalman f(score) v2 score-conditioned noise scaling

nodes.label: f(score) v2 Detection Regression Root Cause
nodes.summary: Low-score measurement R inflation causes Kalman state lag behind measurement, reducing IoU alignment. AssA gain and DetA loss share the same root cause, inseparable in current architecture.
nodes.norm_label: f(score) v2 detection regression root cause

nodes.label: σ(h,s) = g(h)·f(s) Multiplicative Decomposition Valid
nodes.summary: For score >= 0.776 (~88% detections), var-ratio is flat across h bins → multiplicative decomposition holds. Score multiplier does not depend on h. C < D is due to g(h) being harmful, not form error.

nodes.label: Revival Conditions for Kalman Score-Conditioned R Inflation
nodes.summary: Decouple: score-conditioned inflation only applied to association/gating S (or compute_S_inv), not state update/output R. Or conditionally enable when GMC residual/camera motion is low.
nodes.norm_label: revival conditions for kalman score-conditioned r inflation

nodes.label: Q Velocity Term (|Δv|) Skipped
nodes.summary: |Δv| mis-shaped; fit confounded by camera motion. Static sequences (02/04) σ≈0.1, moving-camera (05/13) σ=2.3-3.7. Q ablation skipped since B (g(h)) was negative.

nodes.label: Occlusion Features Mediated by Detection Score
nodes.summary: det_occ, gt_occ, gt_vis all have partial correlation ≈ 0 after controlling for score. Occlusion does not need independent entry into measurement noise model.
nodes.norm_label: occlusion features mediated by detection score

nodes.label: GMC Box-Residual Common-Mode Correction NO-GO
nodes.summary: All GMC residual correction modes (translation/affine, all-track/lost-only) degrade IDF1 (74.3-74.8 vs 75.1 baseline). GT upper-bound co-mode removal does not transfer to innovation space.

nodes.label: GMC Correction Dose-Response: Damage Proportional to Magnitude
nodes.summary: Cap reduction from 10px to 2px reduces damage monotonically but never crosses zero — harm comes from the applied correction itself, not implementation bugs.
nodes.norm_label: gmc correction dose-response: damage proportional to magnitude

nodes.label: Lost-Only GMC Correction Still Degrades Performance
nodes.summary: Even lost-only correction degrades (IDs 508 vs 482 baseline). Root cause: GT trajectory co-mode removal operates in static-reference coordinates; tracker innovation co-mode is relative to already-adaptive predictions.
nodes.norm_label: lost-only gmc correction still degrades performance

nodes.label: Double-Counting by Matched-Track Correction
nodes.summary: Correcting matched tracks' innovation double-counts Kalman steady-state lag that the update step was already going to absorb. Lost-only reduces but does not eliminate damage.

nodes.label: Revival: Tile-Based Phase Correlation GMC
nodes.summary: Revival requires correction signal from independent measurement (tile-based phase correlation sub-block displacement → affine), not from innovation self-feedback loop.

nodes.label: GMC Residual Correction Implementation Retained (Default Off)
nodes.summary: CUDA kernel gmc_residual_correction_kernel in tracker_gpu.cu with median-anchored trimmed-mean + centered affine LS. CLI --gmc-rc-mode 0..4. CUDA-graph compatible. Bit-exact verified.
nodes.norm_label: gmc residual correction implementation retained (default off)

nodes.label: M4-b Native Identity Resolver: Phase A/B/C Complete
nodes.summary: Phases A (Python facade), B (C++ TrackletLifecycleMergerCpp + IdentityResolverCpp), C (cleanup -100 lines) all completed 2026-04-30. 30 tests all passing.
nodes.norm_label: m4-b native identity resolver: phase a/b/c complete

nodes.label: IdentityResolver Facade Design Pattern
nodes.summary: Facade composes SemanticRelinker + TrackletLifecycleMerger into single resolve_pass() call. Eliminates Python list stitching between relink and lifecycle stages. Fallback chain: Native → Python → legacy.

nodes.label: Byte-Identical C++ vs Python Parity for Identity Resolution
nodes.summary: C++ TrackletLifecycleMergerCpp and IdentityResolverCpp produce byte-equal IDs, alias, and stats vs Python. Parity tests cover None embeddings, disabled state, relink match cases.
nodes.norm_label: byte-identical c++ vs python parity for identity resolution

nodes.label: JDE v4 Stretch-Resize Training Effective for Market-1501
nodes.summary: v4 stretch-resize 640x640 (no padding) + global pool + trainable emb_head: loss decreasing 3.88→2.95 over 7 epochs. v1/v2 letterbox 95% padding drowned signal. v3 RoIAlign on random init emb_head failed (gradient=0).
nodes.norm_label: jde v4 stretch-resize training effective for market-1501

nodes.label: RoIAlign Pool Failure with Random-Init emb_head
nodes.summary: RoIAlign spatial average on randomly-initialized per-pixel embeddings produces near-identical pooled embeddings for all person crops → SupCon converges to maximum entropy baseline (loss ≈ ln(63)).
nodes.norm_label: roialign pool failure with random-init emb_head

nodes.label: JDE Three-Stage Training Pipeline Proposal
nodes.summary: Phase A: stretch+global_pool+high LR pretrain emb_head; Phase B: letterbox+RoIAlign fine-tune projector (emb_head frozen); Phase C: unfreeze all, joint fine-tune.

nodes.label: GStreamer NVDEC Zero-Copy GPU Decode Pipeline
nodes.summary: GstZeroCopyDecoder: NVDEC (nvh264dec) → NV12 GPU output → _nv12_to_rgb_gpu (BT.601, CUDA tensor, no CPU copy). 100% GPU-side end-to-end decode and color conversion.
nodes.norm_label: gstreamer nvdec zero-copy gpu decode pipeline

nodes.label: C++ GstClient 5-Buffer Atomic State Machine
nodes.summary: POOL_SIZE=5 GPU buffer pool with EMPTY→WRITING→READY→PROCESSING atomic states. Independent cudaStream_t per buffer. Auto frame drop when pool full. PyBind exposes pointers for torch.cuda.ExternalStream.

nodes.label: RTSP/MediaMTX Canonical Contract
nodes.summary: Standard RTSP defaults: 127.0.0.1:8554, reader/publisher credentials, path naming convention (live/stream_id/detected). Helper module build_rtsp_url() preferred over manual URL construction.

nodes.label: Stream Recovery with Exponential Backoff
nodes.summary: 5s frame-grab timeout → media.release() → exponential backoff reconnect (1s/2s/4s/8s). SmartTracker clears IDs lost >10s during outage. Recover within 10s.

nodes.label: L3 Async Buffering Layer Design
nodes.summary: L3 isolates high-FPS perception from slow DB writes via asyncio EventLoop + Redis cache + 100ms micro-batch aggregation. Early design, not fully implemented.

nodes.label: SigLIP 2 ReID Feature Extractor Upgrade
nodes.summary: SigLIP 2 upgraded for stronger contrastive representation. FeatureBank uses pre-allocated fixed-size tensor + O(1) slot_map dict indexing, eliminating GPU nonzero() sync overhead.

nodes.label: MOT17 Appearance Identity Ceiling: Fundamental Limitation
nodes.summary: 2026-06-03 comprehensive investigation: 5 models + 4 mechanisms + SR + domain training all NO-GO. MOT17 identities intrinsically hard to distinguish in embedding space: clear 200+px boxes rank-1 only 57%, intra-inter gap ~0.03.
nodes.norm_label: mot17 appearance identity ceiling: fundamental limitation

nodes.label: LaSt-ViT Post-Hoc Integration NO-GO
nodes.summary: LaSt-ViT Phase 2C tracker integration: IDF1 +0.09pp (44.85%→44.94%), far below +1.0% GO threshold. Root cause: LaSt-ViT gains come from training-time backbone correction, not inference formula. SigLIP2's last_hidden_state stability scores uniform ~0.12 across FG/BG.

nodes.label: LaSt-ViT CUDA Kernels Retained for Future Use
nodes.summary: 5 CUDA kernels (cuFFT, Gaussian low-pass, Top-K aggregation) + FeatureExtractor::extract_with_stability() C++ API + Python wrapper retained. 18/18 C++/Python parity tests passed.
nodes.norm_label: last-vit cuda kernels retained for future use

nodes.label: LaSt-ViT Phase 0 Python Prototype Results
nodes.summary: Dual-sigma pipeline (σ_embed=0.015, σ_gate=0.040): cosine gap +0.0149 over baseline image_embeds. FG/BG stability discriminability p=0.022 (Mann-Whitney U). Post-hoc approach workable but limited.

nodes.label: Semantic Relink Best Configuration (IDF1 +1.3pp)
nodes.summary: Best: reid-mode semantic, threshold 0.95, spatial-gate 0.20, min-iou 0.20. SDP IDF1 44.6%→45.9%, MOTA unchanged 32.8%, IDs flat 604→603. FPS cost 154→83.

nodes.label: Two-Track Architecture: Motion/IoU Primary + Semantic Relink Conservative
nodes.summary: ReID should not dominate per-frame association (tracker mode increases IDs). Semantic relink as conservative post-fragmentation long-chain repair is safer. Body-part embeddings have signal but 3x cost.
nodes.norm_label: two-track architecture: motion/iou primary + semantic relink conservative

nodes.label: ReID Backbone Ranking: SigLIP2 > TransReID > OSNet
nodes.summary: Accuracy: siglip2@0.90 (IDF1 45.4). Lower-IDs alternative: transreid@0.86 (IDF1 44.5, IDs 829). Speed-balanced: osnet@0.82 (IDF1 44.6, +6-9 FPS). Bottleneck is policy design, not backbone.
nodes.norm_label: reid backbone ranking: siglip2 > transreid > osnet

nodes.label: Semantic Relink Benefits Occlusion-Heavy Sequences
nodes.summary: MOT17-02: IDF1 +1.9 (31.2→33.1), IDs 87→82. MOT17-04: IDF1 +1.6 (44.2→45.8), IDs 117→112. ReID useful specifically for reducing fragmentation on hard-occlusion sequences.

nodes.label: Dynamic ReID Trigger: Lost-Signal Weight > Motion Instability
nodes.summary: Dominant failure = mature track disappears during occlusion → new ID born nearby. Lost events should carry more weight than raw motion jitter. Moving-camera sequences amplify weak triggers; GMC correction needed for geometry signal.
nodes.norm_label: dynamic reid trigger: lost-signal weight > motion instability

nodes.label: Score-Based EMA Trigger Architecture
nodes.summary: Four signal components (new/lost/geom/conf) with per-frame EMA smoothing (decay=0.8), weighted fusion, birth/death boost, cooldown (8 frames), hard persistence gate (3 frames). Hysteresis dual-threshold prevents oscillation.

nodes.label: Dynamic Trigger Best Configuration: p3_t40_cd8_bm3_l35
nodes.summary: Score-threshold=4.0, low-threshold=3.5, cooldown=8, persist=3, birth_death_lost_min=0.3. On MOT17-04: IDs=152, IDF1=43.4%, MOTA=30.9% (FPS 35-40). On MOT17-10: IDF1 +3.4pp via hysteresis FPS recovery (+11 FPS).

nodes.label: GMC-Corrected Geometry Signal for Dynamic Trigger
nodes.summary: Architectural bug found: bbox history was comparing raw absolute coordinates, ignoring camera ego-motion. Fix: pass gmc_warp (2x3 affine) into controller, project prev_box to current coordinate space.
nodes.norm_label: gmc-corrected geometry signal for dynamic trigger

nodes.label: Geometry Moving-Average Smoothing Rejected
nodes.summary: Asymmetric smoothing (raw curr / smoothed prev) amplifies constant-velocity drift by (W-1) factor, harmful for moving-camera. Detection jitter already below center-shift threshold → smoothing gains nothing. Removed from codebase.

nodes.label: Mamba v14-R Controlled Protocol (Frozen 2026-06-12)
nodes.summary: Fixed seed 20260612, MOT17-02-SDP held-out for selection, MOT17-04/05/09/10/11/13 for training. clip_len=4/stride=4, d_state=16, ungated cache. Detector selection by size-binned recall, NOT training loss.

nodes.label: Strict-Clean v14-R Protocol Blocked by Distillation Provenance
nodes.summary: train_mamba_head.py lacks full reproducibility contract (deterministic seed, safe optimizer/scheduler resume, artifact provenance manifest). Gated teacher stage prepared; distillation/cache regeneration required.
nodes.norm_label: strict-clean v14-r protocol blocked by distillation provenance

nodes.label: Mamba v14-R Fixed Artifact Lineage
nodes.summary: Lineage: yolo26s.pt → gated_det_v1/best.ckpt → trt_feat_cache_v2 → mamba_distill_cs_n16/best.ckpt. Cache features cosine sim >0.99999 vs current teacher but provenance manifest missing.

nodes.label: Mamba v14-R Resume Contract
nodes.summary: --resume requires model+optimizer+scheduler state. LR change or legacy ckpt continuation requires --resume-reset-optimizer. Must retain identical seed, split, batch, accum, clip_len, clip_stride.

nodes.label: FeatureBank Vectorized Matrix Implementation
nodes.summary: Pre-allocated torch.zeros((max_ids, feat_dim)) tensor + slot_map Dict[(track_id, stream_id), row_index] for O(1) dual-hash indexing. find_matches_batch uses torch.mm vectorized cosine similarity.

nodes.label: L2 Vector & Deduplication Layer Architecture
nodes.summary: SigLIP2 TRT inference (batch 8, avg 0.82ms), EMA centroid fusion (α=0.7 warmup), Salience Truncator, Saccade Heartbeat (every 10 frames, IDt -64%, ReID compute -90%), Priority Batching (P0: new, P1: warmup, P2: stable).

nodes.label: Mamba Head Features for Relink NO-GO
nodes.summary: Mamba head detection features lack individual discriminability (hard pool AUC 0.438). Consistency ≠ discriminability. Detection features provide no identity signal, consistent with ROI FPN finding.
nodes.norm_label: mamba head features for relink no-go

nodes.label: Kalman h-Sigma Parameter Fitting Pipeline
nodes.summary: scripts/tools/fit_kalman_h_sigma.py: 1.4826·MAD WLS fit on 92,980 matched dets. g(h): σ_px = 0.2005+0.005101·h (score≥0.94 sublinear). f(s): s0 = 0.9305 grid-search. Fit constants at rescreen_logs/analysis/kalman_fit_constants.txt.

nodes.label: Cross-Scan Mamba (4-Directional)
nodes.description: Four-directional spatial scanning that rotates/flips feature maps across 4 dimensions (horizontal forward, transposed, vertical flip, horizontal flip), processes them through Mamba, then reverses and averages. Eliminates row-major bias with zero parameter growth.

nodes.label: PixelShuffle Learned Upsampling
nodes.description: Learned upsampling layer replacing bilinear interpolation using nn.Conv2d + nn.PixelShuffle. MOTA +14.3pp vs F.interpolate. Includes automatic fallback to bilinear when loading legacy weights.

nodes.label: Hybrid Scale FPN Head
nodes.description: At P3 scale (stride 8, 6400 sequence length), bypasses Mamba scan and uses lightweight depthwise separable convolution blocks (EfficientViT-style). P4 and P5 scales retain Mamba SSM modules.

nodes.label: Temporal Mamba (P2-ST)
nodes.description: Cross-frame temporal sequence scanning using GMC affine matrices for spatial feature warp alignment across T-frame temporal cache. Temporal SSM blocks for inter-frame correlation. Concluded to not work — degrades IDF1 by 13.8pp (v15) and 3.2pp (v17) vs pure spatial.

nodes.label: Joint Detection and ReID Embedding (JDE)
nodes.description: Simultaneous output of pixel-level ReID appearance embeddings (emb_dim > 0). Multi-scale ReID feature maps extracted via ROI Align, projected to 128-dim L2-normalized features using pre-trained EmbeddingProjector on Market-1501.

nodes.label: v14 Cross-Scan N=16 Production Checkpoint
nodes.description: Final production checkpoint: IDF1 72.4%, MOTA 77.3%. Architecture: Cross-Scan + PixelShuffle + N=16 SSM fix, pure spatial, no temporal blocks. Achieved via CUDA selective-scan N=16 correction on existing Cross-Scan parent.

nodes.label: CUDA Selective Scan Kernel
nodes.description: Custom CUDA selective_scan_fwd operator in src/tracking/mamba_scan.cu. Each (B, D) pipeline maps to one CUDA block using warp-level shuffle instructions. Linear scaling with sequence length L and batch size B. Kernel uses A.shape[-1] to determine d_state (N).

nodes.label: SSM State Dimension N Bug (Fixed)
nodes.description: Early kernel mistakenly used A.shape[0] as dstate. With A_log shape (1, N), A.shape[0]=1 caused TRT/fp16 path to use only 1 state dimension, degrading precision to ~49%. Fixed to use A.shape[-1] for N, making fp16 and fp32 paths consistent.

nodes.label: Temporal Blocks Dual Contributions
nodes.description: Temporal blocks provide FP suppression (-69% in v2) and FN recovery (+18715 in v2) when evaluated in sliding window buffer mode. Key finding: v2 never saw multi-frame during training (frame-by-frame) but naturally learned strong temporal consistency gate during eval buffer mode.

nodes.label: Training Version History and Lessons
nodes.description: v2 (frame-by-frame spatial, IDF1 71.2%), v6 (scratch init → 32%), v7 (time-major stacking → 68.2%), v8 (batch-major all-frames → 70.5%), v10 (freeze temporal + train spatial). Key lessons: cannot train from scratch on MOT17, stacking order affects SSM semantics, all-frames loss weakens temporal gate.

nodes.label: Temporal Direction Closure (2026-05-31)
nodes.description: All attempts to add temporal modules on top of v14 Cross-Scan spatial baseline failed to surpass pure spatial. v15 (+SSM temporal: IDF1 58.6%, -13.8pp), v17 (+TemporalAttention: IDF1 69.2%, -3.2pp). Root causes: all-frames loss never activates pure T=1 path, SSM train-test distribution mismatch, Cross-Scan already provides global spatial context.

nodes.label: Per-Channel A + MOT20 NO-GO
nodes.description: Per-channel SSM A (d_inner independent decay dynamics) with MOT20 mixed training resulted in IDF1 -1.8pp, MOTA -1.8pp, HOTA -1.9pp, AssA -2.0pp vs v14 baseline. Root causes: MOT20 domain shift (high density, different scale distribution), architecture/data confound, MOT17 data scale insufficient for added capacity.

nodes.label: 3-Phase Training Pipeline
nodes.description: Stage 0: Feature cache precomputation. Stage 1: Teacher distillation — MSE loss aligning MambaHead cls/reg to frozen teacher Detect head outputs. Stage 2: GT fine-tuning — MOT17 ground truth with Ultralytics v8DetectionLoss (DFL + CIoU + BCE). Gate feedback via GT box Gaussian heatmaps.

nodes.label: Feature Cache Acceleration
nodes.description: Precomputes frozen teacher backbone FPN feature maps to disk/memory, completely bypassing backbone forward during training. 640 resolution ~5.3 MB/frame, MOT17-SDP 7 seq = 5316 frames ≈ 28 GB. Supports preload-to-VRAM and disk-stream modes.

nodes.label: Frozen Teacher Dependency
nodes.description: Teacher (GatedYOLODetector) is pure frozen dependency during Mamba training: YOLO backbone, Detect head, and spatial gate parameters all requires_grad=False, maintained in eval() mode. BN running mean/variance fixed. Teacher defines input feature distribution, distillation targets, loss geometry, and reachable convergence region.

nodes.label: Frozen SSM Audit Finding
nodes.description: v14 entire lineage trained with _selective_scan output having no grad_fn (raw CUDA forward). A_log/D/conv1d/x_proj/dt_proj never updated from distill init — bit-exact identical to deterministic initial values. v14 is effectively 'frozen structured random SSM mixer + learnable gate/readout/heads'. N=1→N=16 curriculum was eval artifact, not training mechanism.

nodes.label: v14 Checkpoint Lineage Tree
nodes.description: gated_det_v1 → teacher to mamba_distill_pixelshuffle_crossscan → mamba_gt_pixelshuffle_crossscan (Cross-Scan + PixelShuffle + N=1, pure spatial) → mamba_gt_vgt_mamba_v14 (Cross-Scan + PixelShuffle + N=16 fix, pure spatial). v14 does NOT directly load v2 weights; v2 is a separate temporal branch.

nodes.label: Controlled v14-R Re-finetune Protocol
nodes.description: Controlled re-finetune excluding MOT17-02-SDP as small-object-oriented model-selection sequence. Start from mamba_distill_cs_n16 (PixelShuffle + Cross-Scan + N=16), clip-stride=4 covering 99.85% frames, best-by none (no misleading training-loss best.ckpt), candidate selection via held-out detector recall and tracking HOTA/IDF1.

nodes.label: Temporal Branch v2 Training Anomaly
nodes.description: v2 temporal distillation used time-major tensor composition (torch.cat) but head interpreted as batch-major (reshape B,T), causing mixed batch samples in each temporal sequence when B>1. GT script called mamba per-frame without T parameter. Despite anomalies, eval-time temporal SSM unexpectedly brought strong FP suppression.

nodes.label: High-Resolution Retraining (1024/1280)
nodes.description: v14 is 640-trained; running at higher resolution degrades precision. Must retrain head at target resolution. Geometric constraint: head spatial_reduction=4 requires input divisible by 128. Pipeline: cache at target res → GT train warm-start v14 → eval with target res TRT engine. Known pitfalls: selective_scan no backward workaround, coordinate double-scaling, hardcoded anchor FEAT_SHAPES.

nodes.label: mamba_whole_graph Production Baseline
nodes.description: Current headline production preset: whole-detect CUDA graph + T3→T1 ckpt lineage, native_640, ReID off. Frozen metrics: IDF1 77.6, MOTA 78.3, HOTA 69.9, AssA 69.1, IDs 430, 221.59 FPS. Replaces mamba_optimal as the head-CUDA-graph lineage preset.

nodes.label: Detection Design Evolution (Option B→F)
nodes.description: Option B (frozen YOLO) → Option C (joint training) → Option D (Gate+Decoder, NO-GO) → Option E (Gate+Standard Head+FT, IDF1 57.2%) → Option E-v2 (Quality-Gated Temporal Fusion, MOTA 54.2%) → Option F (Mamba SSM Head, active).

nodes.label: CUDA Graph Stream-Bind Fix
nodes.description: Custom selective_scan_fwd CUDA op ran on legacy default stream (stream 0), causing CUDA graph capture to miss the scan kernel. Replay missing scan → cls saturation → ~10x FP → MOTA crash. Fixed: pybind binding adds stream_ptr, op passes current stream, graph path uses torch.cuda.make_graphed_callables. Result: bit-exact parity, FPS 95.5→110.2 (+15%).

nodes.label: Detection Module GO/NO-GO Decisions
nodes.description: GO: mamba_whole_graph baseline, Option F Mamba Gated Detector, CUDA graph fix, T3→T1 curriculum. NO-GO: Option D Track-Conditioned YOLO, horizontal-flip TTA, MOT20 mixed training, temporal SSM/attention, small-object high-res recovery (ROI NO-GO), per-channel A.

nodes.label: Flow-Gated Feature Modulation
nodes.description: Replaced Option E-v2's F.grid_sample spatial warp (caused aliasing artifacts, MOTA -2.1pp). Current approach concatenates accumulated GMC affine matrix as dense flow field with feature maps via channel concatenation (torch.cat([x_up, flow_i], dim=1)), using convolutional layers for adaptive spatial gating modulation (1.0 + gate).

nodes.label: mamba_whole_graph Deep Analysis Report
nodes.description: Production baseline analysis at 175 FPS, 5.7 ms/frame. Three-layer CUDA graph architecture: L1 Whole-Detect (TRT backbone + Mamba head + postprocess, ~280→1 replay), L2 NMS Graph, L3 Tracker Graph. IDF1 73.4%, MOTA 76.9%, HOTA 66.6% on 7-seq SDP.

nodes.label: Three-Layer CUDA Graph Architecture
nodes.description: L1 Whole-Detect Graph: resize→TRT backbone→Mamba head→postprocess decode (~280→1 kernel launch, detect 7.4ms→3.25ms). L2 NMS Graph: C++/CUDA NMS pipeline. L3 Tracker Graph: GPUByteTracker update (Kalman + association, 1.4ms→0.53ms). Graph-safe design: fixed shape top-K, precomputed anchor grid, tensor fill for coordinate rescale.

nodes.label: MambaBlock Internal Data Flow
nodes.description: Input u (B×L×128) → in_proj splits to [x, z] (B×L×256 each). x branch: conv1d(k=4, causal) → SiLU → x_proj to [dt, B, C] → selective_scan_fwd(x, dt, A, B, C) → y. Gate: y ⊙ SiLU(z). out_proj: 256→128. SSM dynamics: h_t = Ā_t·h_{t-1} + B̄_t·u_t, y_t = C_t·h_t, with Ā=exp(Δt·A), B̄=Δt·B.

nodes.label: Whole-Graph Stage Performance Breakdown
nodes.description: detect 3.25ms (51%), fetch 2.08ms (32.7%), postprocess 1.84ms (28.9%), track 0.53ms (8.3%), ingest_preprocess 0.20ms (3.1%), total 6.36ms. FP hard filter dominates postprocess GPU (54.5%, 0.96ms). Production mode 175.4 FPS vs profile mode 157.1 FPS (~10% profiling overhead).

nodes.label: Nsight Systems GPU Kernel Analysis
nodes.description: 4 CUDA graphs confirmed (78 cudaGraphLaunch / 20 frames). Top GPU kernels: cutlass TRT conv 17.5%, selective_scan_fwd 6.8% (68µs/frame), tracker stage1_cost 5.3%. 2794 un-graphed kernel launches remain (~140/frame). Mamba SSM kernel extremely efficient at 1.36ms total for 20 frames.

nodes.label: Ablation: GMC is Only Positive Module
nodes.description: Cumulative ablation on mamba_whole_graph: Bare tracker IDF1 18.3%. +GPU GMC: IDF1 +2.0pp, IDs -63% (106→39). +ReID branch: IDF1 -0.3pp, FPS -26.3. +Appearance bank: ±0.0pp. +Async pipeline: ±0.0pp. GMC accounts for 100% of IDF1 gain; ReID is negative contribution when GMC is ON.
nodes.norm_label: ablation: gmc is only positive module

nodes.label: Speed Preset vs mamba_whole_graph Comparison
nodes.description: Detector: YOLO26s TRT → TRT Backbone + Mamba head (IDF1 +21.4pp). Detect CUDA graph: none → whole-detect (detect 7.4→3.25ms). Input: 960 letterbox → 640 stretch-resize. ReID: partial ON → OFF. match_thresh 0.66→0.50. kalman_r_scale 1.0→2.8. fuse_score_weight 0.4→0.0.

nodes.label: mamba_whole_graph Design Limitations
nodes.description: Trade-offs: ReID/appearance must be OFF (tracker graph no per-det embeddings), dynamic batch size unsupported (graph fixed shape), Temporal Mamba not used (degrading), Hybrid head not used (v14 full Mamba), detection quality scaling off (Mamba internal calibration). Unsuitable for: cross-camera ReID, appearance-dependent downstream tasks, dynamic resolution scenarios.

nodes.label: Optimization Opportunities
nodes.description: Immediate: FP hard filter moved to postprocess front (0.96→0.5ms), backbone swap to yolo26n (detect 3.25→~2.0ms), DALI prefetch tuning. Medium: Mamba head INT8 quantization, all-native postprocess, merge postprocess into whole-detect graph. Long-term: end-to-end CUDA graph including DALI fetch, Mamba head TRT export.

nodes.label: Option E-v2 Alpha Tier Per-Track-State Gating
nodes.description: Blend strength differentiated by track state: tentative/new region α=0.05, confirmed age 1-10 α=0.15, confirmed age >10 α=0.05, pure prediction (det_idx=-1) α=0.20. Age decay Q' = Q × max(0, 1 - age/100) prevents static FP long-term lock-in.
nodes.norm_label: option e-v2 alpha tier per-track-state gating

nodes.label: Option E-v2 Lock-in Detection Test
nodes.description: Longest sequence (MOT17-04, 1050 frames) FP analysis: baseline 2879 → α_tier 2152 (-25%). Sequence 05: 80→40 (-50%). No lock-in problem confirmed. Age decay (100-frame window) effectively prevents static FP long-term locking.

nodes.label: v14 Replication Protocol (V14-REPLICA-20260612)
nodes.description: Full replication of legacy v14 training chain from raw yolo26s.pt. Stages: gated teacher → immutable 7-sequence teacher cache → Cross-Scan + PixelShuffle distill → live-teacher GT1 (gt_ratio=0.5) → cached GT2 (fixed N=16, frozen SSM). Deliberately preserves historical 02 leakage structure. Replica IDF1 73.4 vs legacy 75.1; residual -1.7pp attributed to teacher prior + irrecoverable factors.

nodes.label: v14 Replica Results
nodes.description: Full chain replica results: MOT17-02 recall@0.25 all 0.920 (vs legacy 0.940), 4-8px 0.826 (vs 0.871). IDF1 73.4, MOTA 77.3, HOTA 65.3. Verdict: recipe substantively reproducible, teacher prior + frozen-SSM regime recovered most of strict-route 46pp recall collapse. Residual -1.7 IDF1 from irrecoverable factors (seed, scheduler, N=1-era warm-start).

nodes.label: SSM Unfreeze Fine-Tuning (ssmft)
nodes.description: Warm-start replica final with --no-scan-stop-grad (SSM internals first-time gradients) for 30 more epochs. Results: neutral to slightly positive (MOTA/HOTA +0.8). Train loss improves (2.548→2.149) but doesn't convert to detector recall. A_log max Δ only 0.010. Full-grad itself not toxic; strict run degradation from teacher prior and convergence dynamics.

nodes.label: Multi-Seed Noise Bandwidth
nodes.description: Full student chain (distill→GT1→GT2) reseeded ×2. IDF1 band [73.0, 73.4], span 0.4pp. Noise concentrated in precision side (FP ±23%), recall stable across seeds. v14 legacy's 1.7pp residual is 4x the bandwidth — not seed noise. Attribution maintained: teacher prior + other irrecoverable factors.

nodes.label: T3→T1 Temporal-Shaping Curriculum
nodes.description: GT2 replaced with two-phase curriculum: Phase A clip_len=3 stride=6 15ep (--add-temporal), Phase B clip_len=1 stride=2 15ep (temporal bypass, pure spatial re-adaptation). For the first time surpasses legacy v14: IDFI 75.4 vs 75.1. Gain mechanism: T=3 training imposes cross-frame consistency on spatial path; temporal blocks bypassed at inference, zero deployment cost.

nodes.label: T3→T1 Multi-Seed Paired Verification
nodes.description: 3-seed paired comparison (each seed from own GT1 warm-start): seed42 +2.1 IDFI, seed13 +2.3, seed14 +0.4. Mean +1.6. Difficult sequences (02/05/10/13) 12/12 positive. s14's +0.4 attributed to lucky baseline high point on MOT17-11, not shaping failure. Gain is real and structurally stable.

nodes.label: Curriculum Ordering and Gain Retention
nodes.description: T3→T1: IDFI 75.4. T3T1→ssmft (wrong order): 73.8, AssA -3.2 back to plain GT2 level. ssmft→T3T1 (reverse): 74.3, AssA only recovers to 63.6. Design rule: last curriculum segment's objective determines final feature configuration; shaping to preserve must be last or protected by explicit loss terms.

nodes.label: v14 Direct Conversion Ablation (Zero Training)
nodes.description: Three-point decomposition: parent+N=1 runtime → parent+N=16 runtime → final v14+N=16. Direct N=1→N=16 conversion gives only +0.1 IDFI; real jump (+2.6 IDFI, +3.5 MOTA, +3.0 HOTA, FN -4136) happens in subsequent GT run at fixed N=16. v14 = Cross-Scan parent re-adapting readout/gate/heads in corrected N=16 forward coordinate system.

nodes.label: Controlled Frozen-SSM N=16 Refit
nodes.description: From historical parent mamba_gt_pixelshuffle_crossscan, only replay last edge: fixed N=16 + scan-stop-grad GT fine-tune 30 epochs. Result: IDFI 75.0, MOTA 77.8, HOTA 68.5. Tensor audit: 21 SSM internal tensors bit-exact vs parent; 48/69 tensors updated. Proves v14 reproducibility = fixed N=16 forward + frozen structured mixer + outer gate/readout/upsampling/detection heads GT adaptation.

nodes.label: v14 Success Factors Summary
nodes.description: 1. Capacity ratio: frozen backbone + 10M head (prevent overfitting on ~5300 samples). 2. Frozen SSM = implicit regularizer (structured random mixer; learning gate/readout more sample-efficient). 3. Teacher prior: mild domain-adaptive supervision. 4. Three-stage curriculum: dense imitation→mixed→pure GT. 5. T3→T1 temporal shaping.

nodes.label: YOLO26m Capacity Control
nodes.description: yolo26m P3/P4/P5 channels (256,512,512) vs yolo26s (128,256,512). Full same-recipe comparison: m-T3T1 achieves recall/MOTA win at IDFI parity. 02 recall@0.25 min_4to8 0.900 (+7pp robust). Detection/small-object recall win, not IDFI win. AssA loss attributed to structural DetA↔AssA trade-off, partially recoverable via eval-time relink bridge gate relaxation.

nodes.label: VGT-Mamba (Velocity-Guided Temporal)
nodes.description: Uses GMC affine flow to warp historical frame FPN features to current frame alignment before temporal Mamba. GMC pre-computed (127 KB). Aims to fundamentally address temporal alignment and reduce occlusion FN. Currently in training (Phase 1).

nodes.label: Hybrid Mamba-ViT Head Architecture
nodes.description: Low-level FPN (P3) uses EfficientViT-style CGA convolution head; high-level FPN (P5) uses Mamba head for global semantics. Balances global context modeling with TensorRT/GPU-friendly inference speed. Pending implementation.

nodes.label: Detector Training Data Improvement
nodes.description: pred_h ≈ 61.4% of gt_h, 77% of approximate FP actually have real GT. Supplement half-body/leg/foot annotations for occluded and small targets, then re-fine-tune. Aims to fundamentally resolve FN; all current score-gate approaches at ceiling.

nodes.label: Kernel Fusion Plan via torch.compile
nodes.description: Three-phase fusion plan: P1 postprocess chain, P2 per-scale cls/reg heads, P3 MambaBlock. Using torch.compile Inductor backend for pointwise chain fusion. P1+P2 achieved bit-exact accuracy, +2.9% FPS. P3 (MambaBlock) fixed fake kernel contiguity issue, final +4.73% FPS (211.47→221.48). selective_scan custom CUDA op treated as black-box within compile.

nodes.label: Strip Detail Routing Design (Parked)
nodes.description: Sparse high-resolution detail routing: only <10% P3 cells needing original resolution get raw pixel strip reading. 1D strip → Conv1d stem → detail MambaBlock → residual addition to x_proj. Gain ceiling <0.5pp IDFI vs high-res deployment cost (+1.4ms). Parked as ROI NO-GO (registry #36). Phase 1 code implemented, default off.

nodes.label: Mamba Score Distribution Analysis
nodes.description: 95,872 GT boxes analyzed. Distribution extremely left-skewed saturated: median 0.932, p05 0.515, 95% matched boxes ≥0.50, only ~2% <0.28. Box height is strongest driver (spearman +0.51). Crowd density hurts via missed detections, not score suppression. All tracker thresholds sit in thin left tail; new_track_thresh effectively acts as small-target filter.

nodes.label: Height-Conditioned Birth Gate: Bidirectional NO-GO
nodes.description: Oracle ceiling analysis: raising threshold for large boxes (FP kill) and lowering for small boxes (recall save) both show upper bound ≤0 IDFI. Detection-layer precision gradient doesn't transfer to output space. Actionable quantity is ~0.3% GT thin tail. Real recall hole is 3788 FN where detection already exists but association/confirmation fails (12x the threshold-rescuable amount).

nodes.label: Confirm-Gate Pareto Analysis
nodes.description: 3788 association FN decomposed: 57% create/confirm delay (confirm_score_thresh=0.50 keeps detections in [0.28,0.50] long-term tentative). cst0.40 saves creation delay (MOTA +1.2/HOTA +0.3/Rcll +2.2) but Prcn -1.0/AssA -0.4/IDs +49, non-negative-impact-free. Six geometric conditioning methods all failed to eliminate negatives. Only surviving: cst0.40 as optional recall/MOTA Pareto point (not default).

nodes.label: Occlusion Crossing-Swap = 22% IDs
nodes.description: 109 mutual-occlusion crossing id-swaps account for 22% of baseline IDs. Two confirmed tracks mutual-occlude (IoU≥0.5) for 1-2 frames then separate, 98% merge to occluder's track. Occlusion-gated speed lock (C++) measured monotonically harmful (AssA -0.4~-5.3). Root cause: MOT17 foot speed below box-jitter floor; speed direction is noise for slow subjects.

nodes.label: Dual-Resolution Mamba Head Research Plan
nodes.description: Proposal: 640 v14 global stream + pre-resize high-resolution detail stream. Detail stream uses shallow stride-4 encoder to preserve fine detail lost during resize. P3 cell footprint mapping (3x3 patch token) with zero-init residual fusion into cls/reg branches. B1-L vs B1-H matched controls show weak positive detector signal (FN -3-6%), but gain mainly in AssA/IDF1, not small-object recovery.

nodes.label: B1-H Weak Positive Detector Signal
nodes.description: Matched B1-H vs B1-L comparison: 4-8px FN reduction 0.4-3.8%, 8-16px 5.1-6.3% depending on score threshold. Paired bootstrap at score 0.25: 4-8px +0.443pp CI [0.052,0.834], 8-16px +0.328pp CI [0.061,0.638]. Upgraded from INCONCLUSIVE to provisional signal GO. However, resolution capacity axis (native 1080, 5x5 patch, 64ch) all at plateau in existing v14 warm-start regime.

nodes.label: Mamba CUDA Graph Eval Bug Report
nodes.description: Two bugs found: Bug A — graph never enabled in eval (grad enabled → eager fallback, use_cuda_graph dead). Bug B — graph enabled but output corrupted (cls saturates to 1.0, ~10x FP, MOTA -28.9%). Root cause: custom selective_scan_fwd CUDA op running on legacy default stream (stream 0), CUDA graph capture only records capture stream work → scan kernel missing from graph → replay missing scan. Fixed via stream binding + make_graphed_callables.
nodes.norm_label: mamba cuda graph eval bug report

nodes.label: T3→T1 Curriculum Full Research Record
nodes.description: Full research record: discovery, verification, and boundary experiments on T3→T1 temporal-shaping curriculum. Core finding: T3→T1 first surpasses legacy v14 (IDFI 75.4). Gain mechanism = shaping pressure, not temporal inference (temporal blocks contribute only +0.7 at eval). Consistency ≠ discriminability (relink embedding AUC 0.438, NO-GO #35). Explicit staging > implicit all-frames (matched 3-seed: +1.8 IDFI, +3.0 AssA, distributions non-overlapping).

nodes.label: T3→T1 Gain = Pure Association
nodes.description: Matched implicit vs explicit 3-seed comparison: explicit T3→T1 staging consistently surpasses implicit all-frames baseline +1.8 IDFI / +3.0 AssA (distributions non-overlapping, p<0.001). With interp/relink disabled: +1.4 IDFI / +2.4 AssA, DetA only +0.34, Recall slightly lower. Size-binned recall near-identical across all bins. Gain is purely association — same detections, better cross-frame consistent box/score for tracker.

nodes.label: T3→T1 Boundary Experiments
nodes.description: T3T1→ssmft (wrong order) DetA +1.3/FN -1688/MOTA 79.4 but AssA -3.2 back to plain GT2 level. ssmft→T3T1 (reverse) partially recovers (+0.5/+0.8 vs wrong order) but AssA 63.6 ≠ 66.0. Weight interpolation shows no synergy peak. Design rule: last curriculum segment objective determines final feature configuration.

nodes.label: AssA Destruction 2×2 Attribution
nodes.description: 2×2 discriminator (frozen×T=1 vs unfrozen×T=3→T1): C3 universal T=1 forgetting is main component (-2.0 AssA from just continued T=1 training even with frozen SSM), C1 SSM unfreeze DOF is secondary (-1.2). DetA↔AssA trade-off is property of single-frame detection objective, not SSM DOF. Cross-frame (T=3) pressure is the protective term; ordering can eliminate most antagonism.

nodes.label: T3→T1 Production Switch (2026-06-13)
nodes.description: mamba_whole_graph and mamba_optimal mamba_ckpt changed to runs/mamba_gt_v14replica_t3_t1/best.ckpt. Verification: preset default produces 75.4/77.6/67.7/69.7/66.0 = T3→T1. Consistency ensured: backbone = raw yolo26s engine (lineage-agnostic), gt-ratio 0 → gate bypassed (train/deploy both see raw FPN features).

nodes.label: Cognition Module Overview
nodes.description: Local Llama 3 edge Agentic RAG with LlamaIndex orchestrator, BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 embeddings, Ollama llama3:8b inference, and ChromaDB vector store. ReActAgent with visual re-query tool. VRAM pressure-aware integration: FAST_PATH skips LLM RAG, EMERGENCY drops non-anomaly frames. Stable, no active ablation.

nodes.label: Motion Module Overview
nodes.description: Object motion consistency verification, track velocity and acceleration EMA smoothing (vel_alpha=0.3, acc_alpha=0.15). Motion-based dedup NO-GO (2026-05-17): 89% candidates blocked by age gate, gain ≈ noise. OA-SORT OAO duration-ramp revived in mamba_whole_graph as tracker cost temporal occlusion penalty. EMA only default.

nodes.label: Semantic Relink Module Overview
nodes.description: Appearance-similarity-based Hungarian algorithm association, rerank for false-accept filtering, cross-camera/long-miss identity association. Implements Sinkhorn Auction hybrid association and Rerank Phase 3. Current mamba_whole_graph headline baseline uses reid_mode: off; primary identity repair from GPU bidirectional bridge relink and tracker core.

nodes.label: GPU Bidirectional Bridge Relink
nodes.description: GPU bidirectional midpoint bridge relink (px=0.25 + scale gate). GO, preset default ON. MOT17-SDP on/off: IDF1 +2.1, AssA +2.8, IDs -13.6%, FP -14% — all metrics strictly dominant. Decision from 2026-06-11.

nodes.label: Cheb-GR Re-ranking NO-GO for MOT17
nodes.description: Cheb-GR k-reciprocal method validated on Market-1501/SigLIP2 (+9.56pp standalone). But on MOT17 mamba_whole_graph: safe operating point achieves 0.0pp AssA/IDF1/HOTA improvement. Strong detection + GMC leaves no appearance headroom. Code retained default off. Decision from 2026-06-03.

nodes.label: Offline Relink Candidate Analysis Hub
nodes.description: Main entry point for relink/crossing-swap/AssA investigation. Bridge full-pool AUC 0.895 but gate operating region only ~0.65 (easy-pool vs hard-pool). Bottleneck = base rate. Area-ratio robust gate. Reach-gate speed term dead weight.

nodes.label: Depth Ordering Crossing-Swap Solution
nodes.description: Occlusion crossing-swap depth ordering: foot_y discriminates front/back with AUC 0.898 (vs appearance ~0.50). Same-height gate GO default-on (+0.5 IDFI, commit c418872b). Decision from 2026-06-14.

nodes.label: v14 Training Artifact Audit (2026-06-12)
nodes.description: Existing v14 best.ckpt is epoch 58, but documented loss 2.87 corresponds to epoch 30. Resume epochs 31-60: requested lr=3e-4 not effective (actual LR only 1e-6 to 3e-6); cache mode made gt_ratio=0.5 gate feedback ineffective.

nodes.label: Checkpoint Resume Semantics
nodes.description: --resume is now exact resume (requires both optimizer and scheduler state, restores actual LR). --resume-reset-optimizer for LR changes, extension of old checkpoints, or loading checkpoints without scheduler state (creates new optimizer + single warmup+cosine schedule). Checkpoint records epoch_loss, epoch_lr, scheduler state, holdout sequences, selection status.

nodes.label: Semantic Relink Module Status
nodes.content: Semantic relink module — no active TODOs. All appearance-related relink paths (Cheb-GR offline tracklet merge and birth-time lost-bank relink) were evaluated and marked NO-GO (AssA 0.0pp / no lambda reduces IDs). Diagnostic tools retained. Code kept default-off. Restart condition: MOT-domain ReID features.

nodes.label: Offline Relink Candidate Analysis — Investigation Hub
nodes.content: Entry point for relink + crossing-swap / AssA bottleneck investigation. Holds offline discriminability and pre-loss kinematics study. Sibling investigations: bridge motion-residual AUC, bidirectional bridge relink, relink normalization gate, depth ordering crossing-swap.
nodes.norm_label: offline relink candidate analysis — investigation hub

nodes.label: Bridge Dist AUC — Easy vs Hard Pool
nodes.content: On full offline candidate pool (19,615 GT-valid pairs), bridge_dist AUC = 0.895. But in the gate's operating region (bridge_dist ≤ 1), AUC collapses to ~0.675. Base rate is 1.3%, so precision is low at any useful recall. Geometry is strong for rejecting impossible candidates but weak on hard near cases. The lever is shrinking the negative pool first via tighter gap/spatial gate or appearance/ReID as first gate.
nodes.norm_label: bridge dist auc — easy vs hard pool

nodes.label: Pre-loss Kinematics — Turning is Jitter Not Signal
nodes.content: GMC-compensated per-frame foot speed median is 0.01 heights/frame (~2 px), below the box-jitter floor. Velocity direction is noise. People walk near-straight — constant-velocity extrapolation is fine directionally provided velocity is estimated over a multi-frame window. Box area is a robust gate (|median| area change ≈ 1.6%/frame). Sharp pre-loss turning claim is retracted — the opposite holds.
nodes.norm_label: pre-loss kinematics — turning is jitter not signal

nodes.label: Speed-Weighted Velocity Term — One Geometric Gain That Survives
nodes.content: Velocity term earns its keep only when target is actually moving. Speed-weighted blend w(s)·(velocity score) + (1-w)·dist_h with w = clip(sqrt(s_lost / 0.12), 0, 1). Offline gain: +0.027 AP (~+8%) via LOSO CV. Online validation: IDF1 +0.6, HOTA +0.5, AssA +1.0, IDs -14 vs legacy bridge. Default bridge_px = 0.25. h_ref = avg(ema_lost, ema_cand) — using avg of both endpoints keeps normalization symmetric.
nodes.norm_label: speed-weighted velocity term — one geometric gain that survives

nodes.label: Reach-Gate Model Rejected — Velocity Drift Is Dead Weight
nodes.content: Every formulation that uses the velocity vector collapses to chance or below. Root cause: per-track exit speed s is at the jitter floor, so s·G is noise × gap. A constant search radius beats a growing one. Reappearance position is dominated by spatial persistence, not blind velocity extrapolation.
nodes.norm_label: reach-gate model rejected — velocity drift is dead weight

nodes.label: Precision Gate Ablation — Scale Gate + Margin
nodes.content: Three gates tested: scale gate [0.75, 1.33] kills 53% of false bridges at zero short-gap TP loss; margin = 0.05 is the dominant gate (+0.3 IDF1, +0.4 AssA); spatial pre-filter is bit-identical to baseline (bridge_px=0.25 already tight). Combined scale+margin default: bridge_margin=0.05, bridge_h_lo=0.75, bridge_h_hi=1.33.
nodes.norm_label: precision gate ablation — scale gate + margin

nodes.label: Crossing-Swap Ceiling — Velocity-Direction Wall Reconfirmed
nodes.content: 109 occlusion crossing-swaps = 22% of baseline IDs. Velocity-direction lock measured monotonically harmful across all tested weights. Root cause: per-frame foot speed at jitter floor, velocity direction is noise for slow bulk. Only appearance can separate true/false identity matches at this scale, but MOT17 embedding hard-pool AUC ≈ 0.50. However, depth ordering (foot_y) later cracks this at AUC 0.898.

nodes.label: h_ref Regression and Revert
nodes.content: Changing h_ref from avg(ema_lost, ema_cand) to ema_lost-only regressed IDF1 -0.4, AssA -0.7, IDs +12. Root cause: asymmetric gate shifting. Reverted in all three paths. The scale gate (§6f) makes the inflate concern redundant.

nodes.label: Depth Ordering Probe — GO Signal (AUC 0.898)
nodes.content: Pre-occlusion box geometry (foot_y primary, area fallback) predicts front/back at ~90% accuracy (97% when cue decisive) across all 7 MOT17-SDP train sequences. foot_y AUC = 0.898 vs appearance ≈0.50. First signal that attacks occlusion crossing-swap bottleneck without dead levers (appearance, velocity-direction). Same-height gate (|foot_gap| ≤ 0.15h) promoted to default-on GO: +0.5 IDF1 / +0.4 AssA, 6/7 seqs non-negative.

nodes.label: Depth Ordering Oracle Ceiling — +4.1 IDF1
nodes.content: Crossing-swap perfect-fix oracle ceiling = +4.1 IDF1 / +4.4 AssA, positive on all 7 sequences. N=57 addressable switch events. All-switch ceiling (+12.5 IDF1) means crossing-swaps alone are ~1/3 of entire association headroom. Realistic expectation: +2…+3 IDF1/AssA if policy is clean.

nodes.label: Depth Ordering Phase-1 — Occluded State Machine Is NO-GO
nodes.content: Occluded(by=A) lifecycle state + depth-consistency cost term was implemented but is NO-GO. Depth cost term is provably inert (bit-identical at w=0 and w=0.6). OCCLUDED state gates on state==CONFIRMED so it removes lost tracks from the bidir bridge, cannibalizing the reconnections the bridge was already making. Classic registry pattern: premise true + mechanism wrong.
nodes.norm_label: depth ordering phase-1 — occluded state machine is no-go

nodes.label: Swap Mechanism Attribution — Occluder Absorbs the Box (72%)
nodes.content: 72% of crossing-swaps are ABSORB mode (existing track took GT's box, 63% by the spatial occluder). 79% of ABSORB events have two distinct hyp boxes at swap frame — detections exist, auction assigned them wrong. Occluder-side depth constraint at auction (mutual-exclusion across pair) is the correct hook, not an additive penalty on the occludee.
nodes.norm_label: swap mechanism attribution — occluder absorbs the box (72%)

nodes.label: Phase-2 Occluder-Side Mechanism — Real But Per-Seq Inconsistent
nodes.content: Occluder-side mechanism (latched front-flag TTL + back-box penalty, no state change) delivers +0.5 IDF1 / +0.3 AssA / IDs -18 but fails per-seq consistency bar (05 regresses -1.1/-1.4). Three hypotheses for 05 regression all refuted (not over-firing, not precision/collateral, not camera-angle depth accuracy). Scene over-fit — conditional, not default GO.
nodes.norm_label: phase-2 occluder-side mechanism — real but per-seq inconsistent

nodes.label: Phase-3 Same-Height Gate — GO Default-On
nodes.content: Flipping gate from different-height (≥) to same-height (≤) transformed mechanism: 05 regression eliminated (from -1.1 to 0.0), FN flipped from +49 to -170. Peak config: occ_ttl=4, occ_cost_weight=0.5, occ_foot_gap=0.15, occ_iou_thresh=0.45. Aggregate: IDF1 +0.5, AssA +0.4, IDs 496→484, FP -240. Default-on GO, bit-exact golden ALL PASS.

nodes.label: Bidir Relink Data Analysis — Pure Geometry Cannot Separate
nodes.content: Across 13,537 attempts on MOT17 train SDP, ROC of every residual is barely above chance (AUC ≈ 0.55). Same-GT and diff-GT distributions overlap heavily. In crowded scenes the wrong person is as kinematically close as the right one. The AssA bottleneck needs appearance/ReID or semantic features. 72 genuine missed relinks were gated out by the bridge_px gate.
nodes.norm_label: bidir relink data analysis — pure geometry cannot separate

nodes.label: Bidir Relink AUC Reconciliation — Hard vs Full Pool
nodes.content: The AUC ≈ 0.55 is the hard-case number (candidates inside gate operating region). On the full offline candidate pool, bridge_dist AUC ≈ 0.895 — but that power is just rejecting obviously-far candidates. Both are correct measuring different pools.
nodes.norm_label: bidir relink auc reconciliation — hard vs full pool

nodes.label: Bidirectional Relink Roadmap — Four Phases
nodes.content: Phase 0 (DONE): CPU relinker with Kalman gates, directional gate, anisotropic cigar cloud, physical speed limit (fixes ID4). Phase 1 (landed, default off): deferred claim + warmup frames. Phase 2 (landed, default off): midpoint bridge bidirectional gate + velocity regression + probability overlap bridge mode. Phase 3 (planned): Chebyshev statistical gate + N_valid fallback. Phase 4 (planned): GPU two-pass kernel in tracker_gpu.cu.

nodes.label: Phase 2 Bidirectional — MOT17 Ablation +2.1 IDF1
nodes.content: Bidirectional bridge relink on mamba_whole_graph SDP: IDF1 +1.2 (73.3→74.5), AssA +0.7 (64.7→65.4), IDs -8 (503→495). DetA -1.4pp is the only regression. Per-frame ID uniqueness fix (split_on_collision) prevents same-ID duplicate outputs. Default stays off per project convention (single positive ablation, wait for multi-config confirmation).

nodes.label: Relink Normalization Gate — h_ref Strategies
nodes.content: Analysis of height reference strategies for foot-distance normalization. L_med (lost median skip 3) improved hard AUC +0.019 offline but could not be reproduced in live-accept simulation — actually lower than bilateral average (-0.013 hard). Averaging with candidate is always a negative operation. Lost tail frame is unreliable; median of last few frames is more stable.

nodes.label: Relink Normalization Gate — Scale Gate Analysis
nodes.content: Scale gate (height ratio) is an independent filter orthogonal to distance normalization. Recommended operating point: [0.75, 1.33] — kills 53% of false relinks at zero short-gap TP loss. Live ablation on MOT17-SDP: IDF1 +0.2, AssA +0.2, IDs -6, FP -74. Below +0.3pp convention threshold but direction matches offline simulation.
nodes.norm_label: relink normalization gate — scale gate analysis

nodes.label: Linear Interpolation Error Analysis
nodes.content: Within-track interpolation error: gap≤20 has error ~3% body height, extremely reliable. Current interpolate_max_gap=20 is conservative but safe, can push to 30. Gap≤20 is already solved by interpolation; relink does not need to handle these.

nodes.label: Track Lifecycle Module
nodes.content: Manages track lifecycle state machine (Tentative/Confirmed/Lost), dead track eviction, and bottom-level Tracker LRU release. Supports AsyncDispatcher LRU Tracker mechanism (max 8 streams). ID stability filter is a module-level option; current mamba_whole_graph preset has it off.

nodes.label: Lifecycle GO/NO-GO Decisions
nodes.content: D2-B new_track_threshold: GO (IDF1 44.0%/IDs 515). ID stability filter: module-level option (preset off). P5-5 Proximity Birth Gate: NO-GO (prox=0.3 caused FN +1038/Rcll -5.6pp). P5-4 Scene-Adaptive/P5-3 Consecutive birth gate: NO-GO/statistically neutral.

nodes.label: Lifecycle Test Coverage Task
nodes.content: Increase test coverage for lifecycle state transitions (Tentative/Confirmed/Lost) and timeout eviction logic in evaluator.py from 40% to 70%+. Part of cross-module test coverage task in main TODO.

nodes.label: Tentative/Confirmed State Machine Design
nodes.content: Introduces Tentative/Confirmed state machine with three-tier detection classification (High≥0.5, Mid 0.40-0.49, Low 0.1-0.39). Tentative→Confirmed requires continuous confirm_streak (N=3) matching + avg_score > 0.5. Tentative→Deleted on 1 frame miss (fast noise clearance). Only Confirmed tracks output. Extra VRAM < 10KB.

nodes.label: Tentative State Machine — Full SDP Ablation
nodes.content: Tentative tuned default (mid=0.40, confirm_score=0.50): IDF1 45.5%, IDs 575, MOTA 32.9%. Geometry scale version lowers IDs to 548 but IDF1/MOTA lower. Adaptive confirmation only experimental. Best default is mid=0.40 confirm_score=0.50.
nodes.norm_label: tentative state machine — full sdp ablation

nodes.label: GPU Zero-Sync Association — Auction Algorithm
nodes.content: GPU Fused Sinkhorn + Parallel Auction replaced CPU Greedy Matching. N=1000: association time dropped from ~7ms to ~0.67ms (>10x throughput). d_states_ transfer eliminated, full pipeline achieves Zero-Copy/Zero-Sync. Tentative/Confirmed state machine integrated into GPU kernel and maintains correctness.

nodes.label: Lazy ReID Arbiter Entry Point
nodes.content: get_tentative_candidates() snapshot API added as observation entry for Phase 1 without changing tracking decisions. MOT17 eval profiling: 0.20 candidates/frame. Lazy embedding profile with transreid: mean cosine 0.852, Pass@0.85 = 58.8%, arbiter approve 62.5%. Synchronous profile cost: 2.32 ms/frame.

nodes.label: Storage Module — Redis + ChromaDB
nodes.content: Redis L3 Shock Absorber with Streams (saccade:stream) for async buffering, max_connections=32, xadd approximate=True with maxlen=10000. MicroBatcher buffers 100ms or 50 items with asyncio.Lock for batch rpush. ChromaStore L4 vector storage with PersistentClient, hybrid_query supporting semantic search + vision vectors (SigLIP 2) + timestamp filters + is_anomaly. backup() cold backup to zip snapshots.

nodes.label: RTSP / MediaMTX Contract
nodes.content: Canonical defaults: host=127.0.0.1, port=8554, read credentials (reader/readpass123), publish credentials (publisher/pubpass123). Path naming: single-camera 'live', multi-stream 'stream_<id>', processed output 'detected'. Build helpers: build_rtsp_url, build_reader_url, build_publisher_url, build_stream_path. TCP transport is default for RTSP.

nodes.label: Redis Event Queue Contract
nodes.content: List key: saccade:events (TTL 3600s). Stream key: saccade:stream (MAXLEN=10000). Consumer group: orchestrator_group, consumer: worker_1. Event schema: event_id (uuid4), timestamp (float), type (entropy_trigger), metadata (entropy_value, source_path, frame_id, objects). Both Redis List and Stream paths coexist — long-term canonical path not fully unified.

nodes.label: Chroma Memory Contract
nodes.content: Default collection: saccade_memories (storage/chroma_db). add_memory() accepts content, metadata, doc_id, embedding. Metadata fields: frame_id (int), entropy (float), objects (comma-separated string), is_anomaly (0|1), timestamp (float). hybrid_query() supports query_text, query_embedding, n_results, start_time, is_anomaly, object_filter with where clause composition.

nodes.label: FastAPI Retrieval API Contract
nodes.content: Endpoints: GET / (status), GET /objects (active object ids), GET /objects/{obj_id} (single object cache), POST /search (hybrid text/embedding query with n_results, start_time, is_anomaly filter). Known gap: GET /objects/{obj_id} assumes richer object history than RedisCache.update_object_track() currently stores (missing first_seen/last_seen for dwell_time).

nodes.label: API/Schema Known Gaps
nodes.content: EntropyTrigger.calculate_entropy() is placeholder logic, not stable semantic contract. Redis List and Stream paths both present — not unified. GET /objects/{obj_id} contract gap between server.py and redis_cache.py. Update triggers: modify event schema, change Redis key/stream/consumer group, modify Chroma metadata schema, change FastAPI request/response shape.

nodes.label: L4 Storage Layer Architecture
nodes.content: L4 is Saccade's long-term memory — large-scale vector retrieval with attribute filtering. Core components: ChromaStore (ChromaDB wrapper for HNSW indexing), DuckDB backend persistence, metadata management (BBox, Timestamp, Confidence, TrackID). Async DB client — all operations non-blocking. Batch insertion: periodic (1s) or quantitative (50 items).

nodes.label: Storage Module TODO — Converged
nodes.content: No active TODO items — module functionality has converged and is stable.

nodes.label: L6 Resource Degradation Strategy
nodes.content: L6 is Saccade's decision brain for VRAM monitoring and graceful degradation. Four-tier hysteresis: NORMAL (<85%), REDUCED (>85%, shrink buffer pool), FAST_PATH (>92%, pause L2 SigLIP2 + L5 RAG), EMERGENCY (>96%, resolution 640→320, target culling confidence<0.4, track_buffer 30→10). Recovery requires -5% below trigger point to prevent thrashing.

nodes.label: Resource Module — VRAM Monitoring
nodes.content: Real-time VRAM monitoring via pynvml, multi-process Named Shared Memory (saccade_vram_level) for cross-process state broadcast, three-tier degradation hysteresis. ResourceManager monitors GPU VRAM occupancy. VRAMLevelWriter/VRAMLevelReader use POSIX Named Shared Memory with 1-byte DegradationLevel. Writer unlinks stale segments on restart; Reader falls back to NORMAL if segment missing.

nodes.label: Resource Module TODO — Converged
nodes.content: No active TODO items — module functionality has converged and is stable.

nodes.label: VRAM OOM Runbook
nodes.content: Symptoms: nvidia-smi VRAM >90%, Detector CUDA OOM, streaming latency >500ms. Emergency procedure: (1) stop L5 cognition, (2) raise SemanticDriftHandler similarity threshold to reduce CLIP extractions, (3) increase frame skipping. Auto-recovery: ResourceManager monitors vram_limit and switches to minimal profile, unloading unnecessary VRAM caches.

nodes.label: Geometry Module — GMC + Kalman
nodes.content: GPU GMC (Global Motion Compensation) fully landed — FFT, phase correlation, and parallel peak-find reduction on GPU. Single-frame GMC time reduced from 0.71ms to 0.28ms (12.5× speedup). GMC affine matrix written to StreamState.gmc_mat_buffer for detection module's temporal flow gate. Geometry hard constraints and adaptive detection quality scaling retained as capabilities; current mamba_whole_graph preset has them off.

nodes.label: Geometry GO/NO-GO Decisions
nodes.content: GPU GMC: GO (12.5× speedup). kalman_r_scale=2.8: GO (IDF1 +1.9pp, IDs -82, FP -940). NSA-Kalman: NO-GO. gmc_fg_mask: NO-GO (background texture dominates PCR peak). vel_dir gate: NO-GO. GMC box-residual common-mode correction: NO-GO (registry #34). GMC rotation series (LK affine, box-residual probe): NO-GO. MOT output box clip: forbidden (MOTA -6.9pp).

nodes.label: GMC Warp Precision Validation Task
nodes.content: Quantify GMC affine matrix reconstruction and alignment error in detection module's VGT-Mamba temporal feature alignment. Verify FPN feature alignment quality after warping.

nodes.label: GPUByteTracker — Full CUDA Zero-Copy MOT Engine
nodes.content: GPUByteTracker is the core L1 MOT engine. Entire tracking algorithm (predict, cost matrix, update) implemented as CUDA kernels — zero D2H/H2D copies, zero sync. Dual-stage Sinkhorn algorithm replaces Hungarian for GPU-parallel matching. Hybrid cost matrix: Cost = (1-w)*IoU + w*Cosine_Distance with Strong ReID Gate (CosSim>0.75 forces match). GMC kernel applies affine correction to Kalman state vector. Dynamic light compensation adjusts R matrix. Full track state machine: Tentative→Tracked→Lost→Removed.
nodes.norm_label: gpubytetracker — full cuda zero-copy mot engine

nodes.label: GPUByteTracker State Machine
nodes.content: Tentative (new tracks, need confirm_streak=3 continuous matches with adaptive confirmation by score). Tracked (stable matched tracks). Lost (unmatched, held in track_buffer for ReID re-match). Removed (exceeding buffer, released). EMERGENCY VRAM triggers Target Culling reducing track_buffer to clear memory.

nodes.label: L1 Perception Layer
nodes.description: Saccade's retina and visual center responsible for real-time high-frequency visual data processing including detection and continuous tracking with semantic filtering for L2. Components: GstClient decoder (nvh264dec, NV12), Preprocessor (NPP GPU NV12→RGB, resize, normalize), YOLO26 TensorRT NMS-Free detector, GPUByteTracker + SmartTracker, ReorderingBuffer (150ms sort window).

nodes.label: L2 Tracker Core / Native Facades
nodes.description: GPUByteTracker, Kalman filter, auction/Sinkhorn association, native postprocess/GMC/ReID facades. Located in src/tracking/, include/tracking/, src/saccade/perception/tracking/.

nodes.label: L3 Appearance / ReID / Relink
nodes.description: Crop, embedding extraction, appearance bank maintenance, semantic relink, optional identity resolve. Budget-controlled expensive decision resource, not per-frame mandatory. Located in src/saccade/perception/tracking/, eval/relink.py, eval/output_bank.py.

nodes.label: L4 Runtime Streaming / Dispatch
nodes.description: Multistream dispatcher, zero-copy helpers, frame pool, eval streaming adapters. Located in src/saccade/perception/dispatcher.py, zero_copy.py, eval/streaming.py, eval/pool.py.

nodes.label: L5 Storage / Event Memory
nodes.description: Redis microbatch, Chroma memory insert, metadata filter, hybrid query. Decouples perception and cognition. Located in src/saccade/storage/.

nodes.label: L6 Cognition / API / Resource Health
nodes.description: Orchestrator, RAG trigger, API server, VRAM degradation monitoring, service health. Slow path, must not block L1/L2. Located in src/saccade/cognition/, api/, resource/, pipeline/health.py.

nodes.label: mamba_whole_graph Headline Preset
nodes.description: Current headline preset: native_640, whole-detect CUDA graph, GPU GMC, tracker graph, bidirectional bridge relink, ReID off. Tracker params: match_thresh=0.50, new_track_thresh=0.28, kalman_r_scale=2.8, oao_tau=0.50, oao_ramp_frames=25, multiplicative_cost=true.

nodes.label: GPU GMC Phase Correlation Pipeline
nodes.description: Global Motion Compensation via GPU phase correlation: FFT → cross_power → IFFT → peak_find. estimate_into() writes directly to device buffer avoiding host roundtrip. Sub-stage profiling tracks FFT/cross_power/IFFT/peak_find segment times. C++ GMC / PyGraphedGMC / SparseOpticalFlow fallback order determined by _build_gmc_estimator().

nodes.label: MOT17 Eval Pipeline
nodes.description: Main active evaluation path: Frame Source → fetch/ingest_preprocess → detect → postprocess → optional ReID budget/crop/extract → GMC → GPU tracker update → materialize → fast MOT emit or optional identity resolve → eval output. evaluator.py is source of truth; runner.py is compatibility shim.

nodes.label: Cross-Process VRAM Sync
nodes.description: AsyncDispatcher writes DegradationLevel (0–3) to POSIX named shared memory saccade_vram_level (1 byte) via VRAMLevelWriter. PipelineOrchestrator reads via VRAMLevelReader each handle_cognitive_event entry. FAST_PATH (>92%): skip RAG, stop HuggingFaceEmbedding GPU calls. EMERGENCY (>96%): discard non-anomaly frames, skip ChromaDB writes. Uses named shared memory (not multiprocessing.Value) because processes start independently.

nodes.label: Dispatcher GPU Tracker LRU Eviction
nodes.description: AsyncDispatcher.trackers as OrderedDict with max_streams=8 limit. get_tracker() refreshes LRU via move_to_end. On overflow, popitem(last=False) removes oldest tracker and deletes it, triggering C++ ~GPUByteTracker to free all CUDA buffers. deregister_stream() supports proactive release on normal stream end.

nodes.label: GPUByteTracker
nodes.description: C++/CUDA dual-stage matching tracker: high/low score + Sinkhorn association, ReID fusion cost matrix, Strong ReID Gate, GPU Kalman Filter. Operates entirely on GPU.

nodes.label: SmartTracker (Python)
nodes.description: Python coordination layer for GMC (global motion compensation), light-adaptive coefficient calculation, and Saccade Heartbeat (SigLIP 2 feature extraction every 10 frames).

nodes.label: Adaptive TTL
nodes.description: Under L6 instruction, reduces track_buffer from 30 to 10 frames to free resources under pressure.

nodes.label: Target Culling
nodes.description: Emergency mode automatically destroys low-confidence targets to free VRAM.

nodes.label: ReorderingBuffer
nodes.description: 150ms sorting window to correct temporal misordering caused by parallel processing.

nodes.label: Zero-Copy Pipeline
nodes.description: Data decoded directly into GPU 5-buffer pool, never returns to CPU. Detection and transport execute on independent CUDA streams.

nodes.label: Frame In-filling
nodes.description: When frame skip exceeds 40ms, virtual BBoxes are automatically generated to maintain tracking continuity.

nodes.label: GMC via OpenCV Optical Flow
nodes.description: Computes affine matrix using OpenCV optical flow to compensate camera motion-induced Kalman state offsets.

nodes.label: Light Compensation
nodes.description: Dynamically adjusts Kalman R matrix based on frame brightness to stabilize nighttime trajectories.

nodes.label: Saccade Heartbeat
nodes.description: Every 10 frames triggers native-resolution SigLIP 2 feature extraction to prevent EMA contamination by blurred frames.

nodes.label: L1 Performance Benchmarks
nodes.description: E2E Latency: avg 6.68ms (P99 < 9.3ms). Throughput: 149 FPS single stream (WSL2/RTX 5070 Ti), 3000 FPS 10-stream aggregate. Preprocessing (NPP): < 0.13ms. YOLO Inference: ~3.12ms. Verified via 5000-frame benchmark.

nodes.label: Tiling Comparison (Legacy)
nodes.description: native_960 outperforms 960p_2x2 tiled on MOT17-04-SDP and MOT17-10-SDP in FN/MOTA. Seam-aware cross-tile duplicate merge reduces tile seam contamination but does not match native_960. Tiled path structurally weaker; threshold tuning alone insufficient.

nodes.label: Tile Diagnostics
nodes.description: Outputs pre_merge_seam, post_merge_seam, merged_clusters, and compression statistics for tiled detection paths.

nodes.label: new_track_thresh Parameter
nodes.description: Decouples low-score association from new ID creation. track_thresh and mid_thresh can stay low so weak detections can continue existing tracks; new_track_thresh controls which unmatched detections may create new tentative tracks. Default: if unset, new_track_thresh=mid_thresh. Best value found: 0.45.

nodes.label: ID Stability Filter
nodes.description: Eval-layer output gate that tracks each raw ID's recent bbox continuity and score EMA. Unstable IDs are not written to MOT output but tracker state still updates internally. Parameters: min-hits, min-iou, max-center-shift, max-gap, score-ema, min-score-ema.

nodes.label: Person Geometry Prior
nodes.description: Bbox-shape filter before tracker update using only geometry: height ratio, aspect ratio (1.0–5.5 strict), area ratio. Targets obvious non-person FPs and malformed tile artifacts. Best strict params: min-height-ratio=0.018, min-aspect=1.0, max-aspect=5.5, min-area-ratio=0.00006.

nodes.label: Geometry Suspect Support
nodes.description: Instead of dropping detections failing person geometry prior, keeps them as internal auxiliary observations: suspect boxes are score-clamped into low-score band (track_thresh < score < mid_thresh), can only support confirmed tracks via ByteTrack stages, cannot open new IDs, not written to MOT output. Improved MOTA from 33.7 to 34.1 vs hard-dropping.

nodes.label: SemanticRelinker
nodes.description: Embedding-based ID recovery using SigLIP2 features. Conservative post-association relink with configurable threshold (best: 0.90), spatial gate (0.20), min IoU (0.20). Has FIFO appearance buffer for stable references over occlusion gaps.

nodes.label: SparseOpticalFlowGMC
nodes.description: Estimates affine warp between consecutive frames using goodFeaturesToTrack + Lucas-Kanade optical flow + RANSAC (estimateAffinePartial2D). Warp passed to GPU tracker each frame; gmc_kernel applies it to all active Kalman predicted states and covariances. GMC effect strongest on moving-camera sequences (MOT17-10-SDP IDs 167→110, -34%).

nodes.label: TrackAppearanceBank
nodes.description: FIFO buffer of last K normalized embeddings per canonical identity. Buffer mean used for matching instead of single EMA. Consistency gate prevents polluted embeddings from creating wrong relink merges. Current base uses consistency_threshold=0.75 (originally 0.82, found too conservative for SigLIP2).

nodes.label: Appearance Consistency Gate
nodes.description: Computes pairwise cosine mean of all embedding pairs in bank. If below threshold, disables ReID for that track (reid_emb=None → IoU-only fallback relink). syncs d_has_clean_embedding_ to C++ tracker so CUDA Stage 2 conditional cost kernel only enables appearance cost path for consistent tracks.

nodes.label: Mahalanobis Gating (Stage 1)
nodes.description: Upgrades Stage 1 gate from pure IoU > 0.3 to IoU > 0.3 OR Mahalanobis² < 9.4877 (chi-sq df=4, 95% confidence). GPU pipeline: compute_innovation_sinv_kernel calculates S⁻¹ per active track (16 floats), Stage 1 candidate gate uses mahal_sq_det() device helper for det box→measurement space [cx,cy,ar,h] 4D vector product. Allows capture after brief occlusion where IoU gate fails.

nodes.label: Online Lifecycle Merge
nodes.description: Online merger after semantic relink, before global output-ID mapping. Keeps recently-lost local IDs, aliases new local ID back to older output ID when temporal, spatial, IoU, and optional embedding gates pass. Can reduce reported ID switches but current gates create wrong merges (IDF1 drops). Disabled by default.

nodes.label: Offline Post-Lifecycle Merge
nodes.description: Builds output tracklets after each sequence, computes spatio-temporal cost matrix (time gap, spatial distance, forward/backward extrapolation, motion-compensated IoU, direction cosine), solves one-to-one Hungarian assignment. Motion-only version over-merges; appearance-gated version with cosine similarity gate + min-sample + consistency checks reduces IDF1 loss. Disabled by default.

nodes.label: NSA-Kalman
nodes.description: Scales Kalman measurement noise R per detection by nsa = max(0.05, (1−score)²). High-confidence detections get smaller R (filter trusts measurement more); low-confidence get larger R (filter stays closer to prediction). Evaluated as essentially neutral on this dataset (FP +11, MOTA −0.1pp); deprioritized.

nodes.label: Tracklet Quality Filter
nodes.description: Offline post-processing removing entire tracklets shorter than N frames or with mean detection score below threshold. QF len≥3 has best MOTA (+0.5pp). QF score≥0.15 has best IDF1 (42.8%).

nodes.label: ReID Phase 2: Bank Inject + Reciprocal Margin
nodes.description: Bank inject is main structural win (IDs 1301→1034, IDF1 +1.4pp, MOTA +0.8pp). Best combined: C+D inject+margin=0.05 (IDF1 45.3%, MOTA 34.7%, IDs 842, FP 16,719, FN 55,723). Reciprocal margin alone inconsistent. Current base uses semantic_bank_inject enabled by default.
nodes.norm_label: reid phase 2: bank inject + reciprocal margin

nodes.label: Current Base SDP Configuration
nodes.description: Default config for scripts/eval/mot17.py: reid-mode=semantic, conf-threshold=0.05, track-thresh=0.05, mid-thresh=0.10, new-track-thresh=0.45, confirm-streak=1, confirm-score-thresh=0.0, person-geometry-prior (strict), geometry-suspect-support, gmc, semantic-buffer-size=10, semantic-threshold=0.90, semantic-spatial-gate=0.20, semantic-min-iou=0.20, appearance-bank-size=5, appearance-bank-min-score=0.45, appearance-bank-min-iou=0.35, appearance-bank-consistency-threshold=0.75, need-reid, id-stability-filter. Baseline result: IDF1 45.4%, MOTA 34.7%, FP 16,687, FN 55,765, IDs 837.

nodes.label: Best FP/FN Recovery Architecture
nodes.description: Detector: keep low-score person detections. Association: allow low-score detections to continue confirmed tracks. New ID creation: require high enough score via new-track-thresh. Output: require short ID stability. Appearance: semantic ReID as conservative post-association relink. Geometry: suspicious shapes become auxiliary support, not direct output. Preserves recall from low-confidence detections while controlling FP.

nodes.label: Saccade vs Ultralytics (YOLO11n+BoT-SORT)
nodes.description: Saccade (conf=0.05): high recall 50.3%, lower precision 77.0%, MOTA 34.1%, IDs 1,289. Ultralytics (conf=0.25): high precision 89.4%, low recall 36.6%, MOTA 31.9%, IDs 349. IDF1 tied at 42.2%. MOTA favors Saccade +2.2pp overall because recall gain outweighs FP penalty in dense sequences. Saccade tracks ~37% more objects.

nodes.label: GMC + Buffer Positive Interaction
nodes.description: GMC corrects Kalman prediction errors → spatial gate rejects more wrong candidates → buffer mean operates on cleaner candidate set → more accurate identity recovery. Neither mechanism sufficient alone; together they compound. GMC+Buffer@0.95: IDS -151 (-11.5%), IDF1 +2.1pp, MOTA +0.6pp vs baseline.

nodes.label: Reciprocal Margin Optimal
nodes.description: margin=0.15 is only notable variant: slightly improves MOTA (34.79→34.82), reduces IDs (862→845), lowers FN (55,589→55,502), but pays with lower IDF1 and higher FP. No reciprocal margin value cleanly beats base as new default.

nodes.label: ID Fragmentation Diagnosis
nodes.description: Output local-ID counts similar (924 baseline vs 913 current best). MOT ID switches increased (656→1,117). Short-lived IDs increased only modestly. Larger issue is fragmentation of longer tracks after gaps, not flood of one-frame IDs. Simple short-lived-ID suppressor insufficient. Failure mode: incorrect identity recovery after occlusion/gaps.
